curriculum.note: The Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics framework is not in this class folder on Google Drive, which holds only scanned resource packs with no text layer, so this map works at sub-strand level. The four strands, the sub-strand names and the eight Thinking and Working Mathematically characteristics are the published Cambridge ones; only the individual objective numbers are missing. Note that lower secondary adds Algebra as a full strand, which primary does not have, and that Cambridge does not report on Thinking and Working Mathematically at sub-strand level. Add the Stage 7 framework and the exact codes can be attached lesson by lesson.

ongoing.blurb: Cambridge sets eight characteristics, working as four pairs. At lower secondary they are not a strand of their own: they are developed through every unit and are the difference between a learner who can follow a method and one who can choose it.

items.title: Specialising and Generalising: trying particular cases, then stating what is always true
Conjecturing and Convincing: forming a hypothesis, then proving it to someone else
Characterising and Classifying: naming mathematical properties, then sorting by them
Critiquing and Improving: comparing methods, then making one more efficient
